purpose.zh: 拉伸身体侧面，缓解久坐腰背紧张
purpose.en: Stretch the side of your trunk to ease tightness from sitting.

text.zh: 手臂上举，身体向对侧慢慢侧弯
text.en: Raise your arm overhead and bend slowly to the opposite side
Keep your hips seated and feet planted.

text.zh: 停3秒，再慢慢回正，不扭转不前倾
text.en: Hold for three seconds, then come back up without twisting or slumping.

commonErrors.en: Lifting a hip off the seat.

cautions.zh: 腰背或肩部疼痛时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your back or shoulder hurts, and stop if the pain continues.
